## What happens The gateway process dies with `fatal error: concurrent map read and map write`, exit status 2 under launchd, and no crash report. A Go fatal error cannot be recovered, so the whole gateway goes down and every client gets connection refused until it is relaunched. The gateway exited five times on 2026-10-26 (uptimes before each exit: about 24 h, 9 min, 45 s, 2 h 41 min and 2.5 min); launchd shows wait status 512 each time as far as it records. Only the fourth exit ran with `GOTRACEBACK=all`, so only that exit has a stack. ## Environment - magpie 0.1.1476 (`/Applications/magpie.app`), macOS 27.2 arm64; gateway on `127.0.0.1:3425`. Which client sent the request is unknown. - The same code is in v0.1.1564 ([`250adf5`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/commit/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a)) and in main as of writing ([`e5dd869`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/commit/e5dd86965b56a8a176790e2c1ade09f9ef554208)): `internal/gateway/vision.go`, `internal/gateway/middleware.go` and `internal/middleware/run.go` are byte-identical to v0.1.1476, and `internal/middleware/middleware.go` only gained reload bookkeeping that does not touch the runtime. moejs is still `v0.1.0-alpha.4` ([go.mod:6](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/go.mod#L6)). ## Stack Abridged to the relevant frames. Line numbers are v0.1.1476's; the links in Cause are v0.1.1564's, which are the same lines except `gateway.go:2544` -> `2589` and `middleware.go:282` -> `288`. ```text fatal error: concurrent map read and map write goroutine 30835 [running]: moejs.(*Realm).InternGoString -> engine/intern.go:167 moejs.(*Runtime).ParseJSON -> runtime.go:430 middleware.(*Run).apply -> internal/middleware/run.go:232 middleware.(*Run).Tried -> internal/middleware/run.go:195 gateway.triedOn -> internal/gateway/middleware.go:78 gateway.(*Server).serve -> internal/gateway/gateway.go:2544 gateway.(*Server).askVisionWith -> internal/gateway/vision.go:395 gateway.(*Server).describe -> internal/gateway/vision.go:337 gateway.(*Server).seenBody.func2 -> internal/gateway/vision.go:455 goroutine 30836 [runnable]: moejs.(*Runtime).Call -> runtime.go:287 middleware.(*inst).call -> internal/middleware/middleware.go:282 middleware.(*Run).apply -> internal/middleware/run.go:236 middleware.(*Run).Tried -> internal/middleware/run.go:195 gateway.triedOn -> internal/gateway/middleware.go:78 gateway.(*Server).serve -> internal/gateway/gateway.go:2544 gateway.(*Server).askVisionWith -> internal/gateway/vision.go:395 gateway.(*Server).describe -> internal/gateway/vision.go:337 gateway.(*Server).seenBody.func2 -> internal/gateway/vision.go:455 created by gateway.(*Server).seenBody -> internal/gateway/vision.go:451 ```

## Cause - `seenBody` describes each distinct image of a request in its own goroutine, up to `visionParallel` = 4 at once ([vision.go:48](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/vision.go#L48), [vision.go:451](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/vision.go#L451)). The trace has two images, so both goroutines exist at once. - Each goroutine runs `describe` -> `askVision` -> `askVisionWith`, which builds the request on a context derived from its own ([vision.go:384](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/vision.go#L384)) and calls `s.serve` directly ([vision.go:395](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/vision.go#L395)). - For an agent request, `serveAgent` begins one middleware `Run` per request ([middleware.go:41](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/middleware.go#L41)) and puts its `gwmw.Tried` into the request context ([middleware.go:60](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/middleware.go#L60)). The inner `serve` reads it back in `triedOn` ([gateway.go:2589](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L2589)), so every vision sub-request runs `onProvider` through the same `Run`. - A `Run` keeps one runtime per middleware for the whole request, on purpose so the hooks share `ctx.state` ([run.go:40](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L40)). `acquire` hands the same `inst` to every caller ([run.go:92](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L92)); `Run` has no mutex ([run.go:42](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L42)), and `acquire`'s check-then-set of `r.insts[i]` is unsynchronized too ([run.go:115](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L115)). `apply` then calls `ParseJSON` ([run.go:232](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L232)) and `inst.call` ([run.go:236](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L236)) on that runtime from both goroutines. - `inst.mu` guards only the timer's `armed`/`fired` flags and is released before `Runtime.Call` ([middleware.go:288](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/middleware.go#L288)), so nothing serializes the Realm. moejs says "One goroutine at a time uses a `Runtime`" ([guide.md:16](https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs/blob/329a0335538af7b462fe2470bb3e64aa473c7a01/docs/guide.md#L16)) and calls the per-Realm intern cache "plain maps, single goroutine" ([intern.go:14](https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs/blob/329a0335538af7b462fe2470bb3e64aa473c7a01/engine/intern.go#L14)). The trace dies on the read of that cache in `InternGoString` ([intern.go:167](https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs/blob/329a0335538af7b462fe2470bb3e64aa473c7a01/engine/intern.go#L167)); `internASCII` writes it ([intern.go:195](https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs/blob/329a0335538af7b462fe2470bb3e64aa473c7a01/engine/intern.go#L195)). - Every `Tried` also ends with `defer r.letGo()` ([run.go:177](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L177)), which calls `ReleaseCallData` on every runtime of the `Run` ([run.go:84](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L84)). A sub-request that finishes first therefore calls into a runtime another sub-request may still be using, while moejs documents `ReleaseCallData` for after a request's last call ([guide.md:21](https://github.com/Calcium-Ion/moejs/blob/329a0335538af7b462fe2470bb3e64aa473c7a01/docs/guide.md#L21)). - Independent requests are not affected: each has its own `Run` ([run.go:53](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L53)), and its runtimes come from a pool ([run.go:96](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L96)). The collision is among the sub-requests of one parent request. ## Trigger In gateway.go, `seenBody` is called when the chosen model can't take images and an image recognizer is configured ([gateway.go:2047](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L2047); for a group, when a text-only member is tried, [gateway.go:2297](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L2297)). The middleware side needs an enabled JS middleware with an `onProvider` hook; `Tried` skips any middleware without one ([run.go:180](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/250adf5ec5341b544d7939c5372e0f9d4286bc1a/internal/middleware/run.go#L180)). The trace is from one request with two images: the two `describe` calls carried 217,474 and 306,482 bytes. No deliberate reproduction was attempted, since it takes the gateway down. ## Suggested fix - Suggestion: hold a per-`inst` mutex for the whole runtime transaction in `Run.Tried`, `Run.apply` and `letGo` (the provider-JSON write, `ParseJSON`, `Call`, `AppendJSON`, `ReleaseCallData`); `inst.mu` does not cover them. - Suggestion: or run the sub-requests' middleware one at a time, or give each sub-request its own `Run`/Realm from the pool. - Suggestion: add a `go test -race` case with a text-only first model, an enabled `onProvider` middleware and a request containing two images. ## Not verified - Deliberate reproduction. - The client that sent the triggering request, and whether the short uptimes after some relaunches were that client retrying the same request. - Whether all five exits had this cause; only one ran with `GOTRACEBACK=all`. - Whether `ReleaseCallData` from another goroutine breaks anything in practice (only the moejs guide was read). - Other operating systems and other moejs versions.
title: gateway: parallel vision descriptions race on one moejs Realm and exit with concurrent map read and map write
